mainEntity.name: How much does Notta cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notta Pro costs $8.17 a month billed yearly or about $13.99 on monthly billing, while Business costs $16.67 per seat a month billed yearly or about $27.99 monthly. Annual saves about 40% on Pro. Staying past 6 months? Then the annual plan is cheaper.

Yes. Notta's free plan includes 120 transcription minutes and 10 AI summaries a month, but each conversation is capped at 3 minutes. That 3-minute cap turns the free plan into a demo. Good for testing accuracy on short clips, but not for real meetings.

mainEntity.name: How much is Notta Pro per year?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notta Pro costs $97.99 a year on annual billing, which works out to $8.17 a month. For that you get 1,800 transcription minutes monthly, recordings up to 5 hours and 100 AI summaries a month. That summary allowance covers about 3 meetings every working day.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Notta Pro and Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pro gives 1 user 1,800 minutes a month. Business offers unlimited transcription per seat and adds video recording, security controls, usage reports, and CRM and Zapier integration, which suits teams that record most meetings or need video. Above that, Enterprise starts at 51 seats with SSO and audit logs.

Barely, on annual billing: Notta Pro is $8.17 a month and Otter Pro is $8.33. Otter's free plan is more usable, though, at 30 minutes per conversation versus Notta's 3. For comparison, Lynkk Free allows 2-hour recordings, and its $15-a-month Pro plan adds prep before calls and Jira tickets after them.

mainEntity.name: Does Notta have a lifetime deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: No lifetime plan is listed. As of October 2026, Notta's pricing page shows only Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise, with monthly prices of about $13.99 for Pro and $27.99 per seat for Business.
